NASA spacecraft discovers large new crater on the Moon

A NASA spacecraft has discovered a large new crater on the Moon. The crater is described as massive and potentially a 'once-in-a-lifetime' find. Its size is comparable to the Roman Colosseum. The discovery was made by a NASA spacecraft.
